college.name: Apex Institute of Technology & Engineering (AITE)
college.accreditation: NAAC A++ Grade (CGPA 3.68), NBA Accredited (CSE, AI&DS, ECE, ME), Approved by AICTE, Autonomous Status under State Tech University

college.campus: 45-Acre Smart Green Eco-Campus with 1 Gbps Wi-Fi, 60+ Hi-Tech Labs, Smart Classrooms, Innovation Incubator

branches.name: Computer Science & Engineering
branches.description: Comprehensive program covering Software Engineering, Algorithms, Cloud Computing, Distributed Systems, Full-Stack Development and DevOps.

branches.name: Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
branches.description: Cutting-edge specialization focused on Machine Learning, Deep Neural Networks, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Big Data Analytics and Generative AI.

branches.name: Computer Science (Cyber Security)
branches.description: Specialized curriculum covering Ethical Hacking, Network Security, Cryptography, Blockchain, Digital Forensics and Cyber Defense Ops.

branches.name: Electronics & Communication Engineering
branches.description: Focus on Semiconductor Design, VLSI Circuits, Embedded Systems, IoT, 5G Wireless Communications and Robotics hardware.

branches.name: Mechanical Engineering
branches.description: Modern engineering including CAD/CAM/CAE, Industry 4.0 Robotics, Thermal & Fluid Systems, EV Powertrain, and Additive 3D Manufacturing.

branches.name: Civil & Infrastructure Engineering
branches.description: Smart City Planning, Structural Analysis (STAAD Pro/Revit), Geotechnical, Environmental Engineering, BIM and Sustainable Construction.

branches.name: Electrical & EV Engineering
branches.description: Power Systems, Electric Vehicle Battery Systems, Renewable Energy Microgrids, Industrial Automation & Smart Sensors.

eligibility.firstYear: Passed 10+2 (HSC) or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/Biotech/CS/IT with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for Reserved Categories of Maharashtra/All India). Valid score in JEE Main (Paper 1) or MHT-CET/State CET is mandatory.
eligibility.directSecondYear: Passed Diploma in Engineering & Technology with minimum 45% marks (40% for reserved category) OR B.Sc. degree with Mathematics with minimum 45% marks.
eligibility.mtech: Valid GATE score + B.E./B.Tech in relevant branch with min 50% (45% reserved).

quotaDistribution.stateCapMerit: 65% seats filled through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) of State CET Cell
quotaDistribution.allIndiaJEE: 20% seats based on All India JEE Main Paper-1 Merit
quotaDistribution.institutionalManagement: 15% Institutional / NRI Quota based on merit guidelines

documentsRequired: Caste Certificate & Caste Validity Certificate (for Reserved categories)
Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (valid up to March 31, 2027 for OBC/VJ/NT/SBC)
Income Certificate issued by Competent Authority (for EBC/TFWS/Scholarships)
Aadhar Card copy and 5 recent passport-size colored photographs
Gap Certificate (if there is a study gap after 12th)
stepsToApply: Step 1: Register online on College Portal or State CAP Admission website.
Step 2: Document Verification at Scrutiny Center (FC / E-Scrutiny).
Step 3: Check Provisional & Final Merit List ranking.
Step 4: Fill College Option Form choosing Choice Code for AITE Pune.
Step 5: On seat allotment in CAP Round 1/2/3, report to AITE Admission Cell with original documents & fee payment.

academicsAndExams.system: Autonomy based Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) under NEP 2020 framework
academicsAndExams.evaluation: Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) = 40% (Quizzes, assignments, mid-term test, practical viva) + End Semester Examination (ESE) = 60%
academicsAndExams.attendanceRule: Mandatory minimum 75% attendance in theory lectures and 80% in practical sessions to appear for End Semester Examinations.
academicsAndExams.gradingSystem: 10-point scale: O (Outstanding 90-100%), A+ (Excellent 80-89%), A (Very Good 70-79%), B+ (Good 60-69%), B (Above Average 55-59%), C (Average 45-54%), P (Pass 40-44%), F (Fail <40%)
academicsAndExams.honorsAndMinors: Students can earn an Honors degree in their parent branch or a Minor degree in emerging areas like AI, Cyber Security, FinTech, Robotics with 18 additional credits.

faq.q: What is the fee structure for B.Tech CSE?
faq.a: The annual academic fee for B.Tech CSE (Open/General) is ₹1,50,000 per year (Tuition ₹1,15,000 + Dev Fee ₹25,000 + Other ₹10,000). For OBC/EBC it is ₹92,500, for TFWS it is ₹35,000, and for SC/ST it is ₹5,000. Hostel & Mess fee is separate (₹77,000 for Non-AC or ₹1,10,000 for AC).

faq.q: What is the cutoff for CSE and AI & Data Science?
faq.a: For the recent academic cycle, CSE closing percentile was 94.8%ile for General, 91.5%ile for OBC, and 82.0%ile for SC/ST. For AI & Data Science, closing percentile was 93.2%ile for General, 89.8%ile for OBC, and 79.5%ile for SC/ST.

faq.q: How are the placements at AITE?
faq.a: AITE recorded a 94.2% placement rate for 2025-2026. The highest domestic package is ₹48.5 LPA (Microsoft), highest international package is ₹62 LPA (Rakuten Japan), and the average package across branches is ₹8.85 LPA (CSE/AI average is ₹11 LPA). Over 240+ marquee companies recruit annually.

faq.q: Is hostel facility available for 1st-year students?
faq.a: Yes! Guaranteed on-campus hostel accommodation is reserved for 1st-year outstation students (3 boys hostels and 2 girls hostels). Amenities include 24x7 Wi-Fi, hygienic 4-time dining, biometric security, laundry, medical facility, and gym.

faq.q: Can I get direct second year admission after Diploma?
faq.a: Yes, Lateral Entry (Direct Second Year B.Tech) is available through State CAP counseling for students holding a 3-year Polytechnic Diploma with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories). We have 10% supernumerary seats in all branches.

faq.q: Are there scholarships available for girl students?
faq.a: Yes, female students can avail the AICTE Pragati Scholarship (₹50,000/year) plus an additional ₹20,000 AITE Women in Tech Merit Grant, along with State Government fee concession schemes.

faq.q: How can I apply for admission?
faq.a: You can apply through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) of the State CET Cell or register on our Admissions Portal. You can also submit an inquiry directly through this chatbot to speak with our admission counselor.
